title.zh: 二分查找：每次砍掉一半

oneLiner.zh: 在一个已经排好序的数组里，用“看中间、砍一半”的方式快速定位目标值。
oneLiner.en: Find a value in an already sorted array by looking at the middle and halving the range.

overview.zh: 二分查找解决的问题是：数据已经有序，但数量很大，逐个扫描太慢。因为有序，我们可以先看中间的元素，再根据比较结果直接扔掉一半不可能包含目标的部分。它要求输入是有序数组，否则“扔一半”的判断就不成立。
overview.en: Binary search solves the case where the data is already sorted but too large to scan one by one. Because order is guaranteed, we look at the middle element and immediately discard the half that cannot contain the target. It requires a sorted array; without order the “discard half” argument does not hold.

intuition.zh: 维护一个“还可能包含答案”的区间 [left, right]。每一步取中点 mid，比较 nums[mid] 与 target：相等就结束；target 更大就把 left 移到 mid+1；否则把 right 移到 mid-1。区间每次至少缩小一半，所以很快变空。
intuition.en: Keep an interval [left, right] that may still contain the answer. Take the midpoint mid and compare nums[mid] with target: equal means done; if target is larger move left to mid+1; otherwise move right to mid-1. The interval at least halves each step, so it empties quickly.

zh: 数组必须升序（或降序统一）排列
en: The array must be sorted ascending (or consistently descending)

note.zh: 每一步把候选区间减半，最多约 log₂n 次比较；只用到 left、right、mid 三个整数，额外空间是常数。排序本身不计入查找的时间复杂度。
note.en: Each step halves the candidate interval, so at most about log₂n comparisons; only left, right and mid integers are stored, so extra space is constant. The cost of sorting is not part of the search itself.

explanation.zh: 把 left 指向下标 0，right 指向最后一个下标。这个闭区间就是当前“还可能藏着目标”的范围。
explanation.en: Point left at index 0 and right at the last index. This closed interval is the current “could still contain the target” range.

tip.zh: 区间用闭区间 [left, right]，所以循环条件是 left <= right，而不是 left < right。
tip.en: The interval is closed, so the loop condition is left <= right, not left < right.

explanation.zh: 计算 mid = (left + right) // 2，把 nums[mid] 与 target 比较。这一次比较就排除了大约一半的可能位置。
explanation.en: Compute mid = (left + right) // 2 and compare nums[mid] with target. A single comparison rules out roughly half of the remaining positions.

tip.zh: 在 JavaScript 里要用 Math.floor((left + right) / 2)，否则会得到小数下标。
tip.en: In JavaScript use Math.floor((left + right) / 2), otherwise the index is fractional.

explanation.zh: 如果 nums[mid] < target，答案只可能在右半边，于是 left = mid + 1；如果 nums[mid] > target，答案只可能在左半边，于是 right = mid - 1。
explanation.en: If nums[mid] < target the answer can only be on the right, so left = mid + 1; if nums[mid] > target it can only be on the left, so right = mid - 1.

tip.zh: 已经比较过 mid 本身，所以新边界要跨过它（+1 / -1），否则区间可能原地不动而陷入死循环。
tip.en: mid itself was already compared, so the new bound must step past it (+1 / -1); otherwise the interval can stay the same and loop forever.

explanation.zh: 当 nums[mid] == target 时，mid 就是目标所在的下标，查找成功并立即结束。
explanation.en: When nums[mid] == target, mid is the target's index: the search succeeds and ends immediately.

tip.zh: 如果题目要求“第一个等于目标的元素”，相等时不能立刻返回，而要记录答案后继续向左收缩。
tip.en: If the task asks for the first occurrence, do not return on equality: record the answer and keep narrowing left.

explanation.zh: 当 left > right 时，候选区间已经为空，说明目标不在数组中，返回“未找到”。
explanation.en: When left > right the candidate interval is empty, meaning the target is absent, so the search reports “not found”.

tip.zh: 区分“没找到”和“下标 0”：返回值通常用 -1 表示未找到，避免与合法的 0 号下标混淆。
tip.en: Distinguish “not found” from “index 0”: return -1 so it cannot be confused with a legitimate index 0.

zh: 在无序数组上使用二分查找：比较结果的“扔掉一半”推理不再成立。
循环条件写成 left < right：会漏掉区间只剩一个元素的最后一次比较。
更新边界写成 left = mid 或 right = mid：区间可能不再缩小，导致死循环。
mid 计算溢出或不做取整：下标变成小数或负数。
en: Running binary search on an unsorted array: the “discard half” argument no longer holds.
Writing the loop condition as left < right: the final comparison on a single-element range is skipped.
Updating bounds as left = mid or right = mid: the range may stop shrinking and the loop never ends.
Computing mid without integer rounding: the index becomes fractional or negative.
